probes.name: hash-line-comment
probes.why: `#` is a comment in jsonic/the shared @tabnas/abnf lexer. The .proto language spec has only // and /* */ comments.
probes.tabnasNote: DEVIATION: accepted. `#` starts a comment in the shared tabnas lexer.

probes.name: backtick-string
probes.why: backtick strings are a jsonic lexer feature; .proto has no backtick string literal.

probes.name: digit-separator-in-field-number
probes.why: `1_0` is a jsonic-style digit separator. .proto intLit has no separators.
probes.protoc:
/tmp/tmplv5vef_0/probe.proto:2:24: Need space between number and identifier.
/tmp/tmplv5vef_0/probe.proto:2:24: Expected ";".
probes.tabnasNote: DEVIATION: accepted. `1_0` is a tabnas/jsonic digit separator.

probes.name: exponent-field-number
probes.why: `1e2` is a float literal. .proto fieldNumber = intLit, so a float is not a field number.
probes.tabnasNote: DEVIATION: accepted. `1e2` lexes as a number where .proto wants an intLit.

probes.name: underscore-suffixed-number-in-enum
probes.why: same digit-separator leniency, in enum value position.
probes.protoc:
/tmp/tmplv5vef_0/probe.proto:2:15: Need space between number and identifier.
/tmp/tmplv5vef_0/probe.proto:2:15: Expected ";".

probes.name: empty-file
probes.why: an empty .proto is a legal (if useless) file; it must not crash the parser.
probes.tabnasNote: agrees with protoc: an empty .proto is legal.

probes.name: single-quoted-string
probes.why: control probe: .proto strLit allows BOTH quote characters, so this must be ACCEPTED. It is here so the probe set cannot be read as 'everything unusual is rejected'.

probes.name: hex-field-number
probes.input:
syntax = "proto2";
message M { optional int32 a = 0x10; }
probes.why: control probe: .proto intLit includes hexLit, so this must be ACCEPTED (as 16).

probes.name: octal-field-number
probes.input:
syntax = "proto2";
message M { optional int32 a = 010; }
probes.why: control probe: .proto intLit includes octLit, so this must be ACCEPTED (as 8, not 10).

probes.name: trailing-close-brace
probes.why: trailing garbage after a complete file must be rejected, not silently ignored.

probes.name: unterminated-message
probes.why: truncated input at EOF must be rejected (the csv/json5 unterminated-at-EOF failure class).
probes.protoc: /tmp/tmplv5vef_0/probe.proto:3:1: Reached end of input in message definition (missing '}').

probes.name: json-object
probes.why: the json5 leniency-leak probe: a jsonic document must NOT be accepted as .proto.

probes.name: unterminated-json-object
probes.why: the exact json5 leak input: '{a:1' errors with the json5 plugin alone but is ACCEPTED through the documented jsonic stack.

tabnasNote: `accepted` is protocs answer; `tabnas` is @tabnas/protos, recorded so the deviation surface cannot silently grow (ts/test/protobuf-conformance.test.ts asserts it).
